## How it works

- [statement] MongoDB CloudFormation resources select AtlasGov with IsMongoDBGovCloud=true in the profile secret, or BaseUrl=https://cloud.mongodbgov.com/. BaseUrl takes precedence when both are set. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/blob/master/README.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] In the resolved June 6, 2025 support incident, MongoDB reported authorization failures when newly added AtlasGov project users tried to create, modify, or view support cases. Its incident workaround was to ask colleagues to file cases on their behalf. (low confidence) — https://isdown.app/status/mongodb-cloud/incidents/398201-mongodb-support-for-atlas-for-government-new-users-not-able-to-create-cases · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov programmatic-access documentation lists Atlas Online Archives, Atlas Triggers, MongoDB Charts, and Atlas Device SDKs as unavailable; it also explicitly states that Atlas Stream Processing is unavailable. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas
- [statement] Atlas Online Archives, Atlas Triggers, MongoDB Charts, and Atlas Stream Processing are unavailable in AtlasGov. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/ · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] When integrated with Datadog, AtlasGov uses the Datadog for Government site `US1-FED`; Datadog lists its site URL as `https://app.ddog-gov.com` and its site parameter as `ddog-gov.com`. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/
- [statement] The AtlasGov region guide requires the `_AW` suffix when supplying a Google Cloud region name to the Atlas API, including through Terraform; the guide gives `US_EAST_1_AW` as its example. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-regions.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government regions and cloud providers

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] An AtlasGov subscription includes premium support. MongoDB states that projects receive support from US persons on US soil and the same support guarantees as Atlas, including a 99.995% uptime SLA. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/support.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] AtlasGov onboarding requires purchasing and activating a subscription or joining an existing organization by invitation; accounts cannot be created through the login page or API. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] Subscriptions are purchased through AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, or MongoDB Sales. AtlasGov cannot be paid with credit cards or PayPal. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/billing.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov disallows social-account login. Passwords expire after 60 days, require at least 14 characters, and cannot reuse the previous 24 passwords. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] Vanta documents an AtlasGov integration using a government-instance read-only API key. It says commercial Atlas API keys cannot authenticate to the government instance; its setup requires an Organization Owner or Project Owner and an API access-list entry for Vanta outbound traffic. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-27) — https://help.vanta.com/en/articles/13355889-connecting-vanta-mongodb-atlas-for-government · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] The archived March 2026 SSO incident attributed some AtlasGov login failures to SSO routing, including bookmarked SSO URLs returning a 400 error. The incident workaround was email-first login at https://account.mongodbgov.com; the archive records resolution on March 31, 2026. (low confidence) — https://rewindex.com/company/mongodb-atlas/incidents/ts5bjz6km9f9 · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] An Organization Owner invites users through the Organization Access Manager and selects organization-level permissions. Invitees cannot change the invited email address or organization during acceptance. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov subscriptions can be purchased through AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, or MongoDB Sales. The activation code applies to the first organization created when the invitation registers a new account. Credit cards and PayPal cannot pay for AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/billing.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] In the resolved November 19, 2025 activation incident, MongoDB reported that activation-code redemption could fail in both Atlas and AtlasGov, with a disappearing save button and an unapplied subscription. Its initial notice offered no workaround and advised retrying after resolution. (low confidence) — https://isdown.app/status/mongodb-cloud/incidents/478487-mongodb-atlas-activation-code-redemptions-may-fail · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov uses Datadog for Government US1-FED for its Datadog integration. Datadog identifies US1-FED with app.ddog-gov.com and documents that its sites are independent and cannot share data across sites. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/
- [statement] AtlasGov requires a standard-region or government-region designation when creating a project; clusters cannot span government and standard regions within the same project. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-regions.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government regions and cloud providers · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-project.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-cluster.md
- [statement] The AtlasGov project guide makes Google Cloud available only in government-region-use projects. A standard-region project can deploy AWS clusters only to standard regions and cannot deploy other cloud providers. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-project.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government regions and cloud providers

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] AtlasGov passwords expire after 60 days, can be changed only once each day, must differ from the previous 24 passwords, and must contain at least 14 characters. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] The mongodb/agents repository explicitly excludes AtlasGov from support for its Atlas Agent Engine templates; this restriction applies to those templates rather than all possible AI applications using AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/agents · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas
- [statement] Fed Gov Today’s interview article attributes to MongoDB Principal Technologist Devin Dickerson the description of Atlas for Government FedRAMP High authorization as forthcoming. The article is presented by MongoDB and Carahsoft, so its roadmap statement is attributed vendor evidence rather than independent certification evidence. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://fedgovtoday.com/google-public-sector-summit/modernizing-government-data-systems-without-disrupting-the-mission · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government FedRAMP Moderate and High offerings
- [statement] Google’s Assured Workloads Americas table lists these US resource locations: Iowa (`us-central1`), South Carolina (`us-east1`), Northern Virginia (`us-east4`), Ohio (`us-east5`), Texas (`us-south1`), Oregon (`us-west1`), Los Angeles (`us-west2`), Salt Lake City (`us-west3`), and Las Vegas (`us-west4`). This is Google’s underlying location list, rather than a tested enumeration of AtlasGov API region values. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://cloud.google.com/assured-workloads/docs/locations · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government regions and cloud providers

## Facts and statements

- [statement] AtlasGov application users are separate from database users; the former access AtlasGov itself and the latter access MongoDB databases. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] For newly registered accounts, the activation code applies to the first organization created. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/billing.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] Organization Owners invite users. Eligible federated users instead become active members directly and receive a notification requiring no acceptance. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] Three failed logins lock an account for 30 minutes. Inactivity suspends password/MFA accounts after 35 days and federated accounts after 90 days. Password recovery uses password reset or Support; federated recovery requires an active IdP account and successful federated login. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov warns after 10 minutes of session inactivity and ends the session after 15 minutes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] The AtlasGov API base URL is https://cloud.mongodbgov.com/api/atlas/v2. It accepts OAuth 2.0 service-account tokens or HTTP Digest API keys; MongoDB recommends service accounts and calls API keys legacy authentication. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] An October 2025 MongoDB notice archived by IsDown reported federated-login failures affecting AtlasGov while existing sessions and cluster health remained unaffected. (low confidence) — https://isdown.app/status/mongodb-cloud/incidents/465052-mongodb-atlas-and-support-portal-browser-initiated-federated-logins-fail · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] The API documentation names cloud.mongodbgov.com as its base host but uses cloudgov.mongodb.com in its service-account GET example. This documentation does not establish whether both hosts work. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] Eligible federated users are added directly as active organization members and receive a notification email requiring no invitation acceptance. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov does not allow signup or login with third-party consumer accounts such as Google, GitHub, Apple, or Facebook credentials. The same access document separately describes federated SAML/OIDC accounts. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] Three failed login attempts lock an AtlasGov account for 30 minutes; MongoDB Support can unlock it. Sessions end after 15 minutes of inactivity, with a continuation prompt after 10 minutes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov suspends password/MFA accounts after 35 consecutive days without login and federated SAML/OIDC accounts after 90 consecutive days without login. Password-account recovery uses password reset or the AtlasGov Support Portal; federated recovery requires an active IdP account followed by successful federated authentication. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] In the resolved December 18, 2023 AtlasGov login incident, MongoDB reported a blank page displaying "no healthy upstream" while cluster health and non-AtlasGov environments remained unaffected. (low confidence) — https://isdown.app/status/mongodb-cloud/incidents/246759-mongodb-atlas-for-government-no-healthy-upstream-error-during-login · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government access, support and account setup
- [statement] AtlasGov supports a subset of commercial Atlas features and some unique features; commercial Atlas documentation alone does not establish AtlasGov feature availability. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md
- [statement] AtlasGov requires cluster tier `M20` or higher and excludes Free, Flex, and `M10` clusters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md
- [statement] AtlasGov supports MongoDB Search, but does not support dedicated Search Nodes: mongot runs alongside MongoDB processes on the same nodes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-search.md · keywords: MongoDB Atlas for Government: FedRAMP regions, feature differences and operations, Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas
- [statement] AtlasGov does not support driver-native Search index management commands; its Search guide specifies the Atlas Administration API or Atlas CLI for managing Search indexes.
